title: Gargoyle Boots

sources.title: Gargoyle's Countenance
markers: | summary = This spell allows spellcasters to harden their skin, granting them Resistance to non-magical physical damage.

summary: Gain +2 to Dexterity saving throws and cast Gargoyle’s Countenance once per Short Rest.

fields.Gargoyle’s Countenance: Self, Action. For 10 turns, gain resistance to nonmagical Bludgeoning, Piercing and Slashing damage. Does not require Concentration.
fields.Base value: 640 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and pinned item and dependency revisions.
